name: Ardor lite
lead_scope: Indian-equity research for NSE cash equities and single-stock futures
summary: Ardor studies market hypotheses through point-in-time information, executable instruments, complete costs and dependence-aware inference. The reviewed evidence records failed strategies, invalid experiments, blocked designs and reusable engineering; it supports zero certified/live Indian-equity strategies.
research_approach: Separate information availability from decision and execution clocks.
Freeze the hypothesis and controlling gates before opening returns.
Compare gross signals with exact instrument, fill, cost and capacity evidence.
Treat dependence, factors, placebo calibration, multiplicity and selection as parts of inference.
Retain null, invalid and blocked outcomes with their original scope.
